findings.title: Mutable action reference actions/cache@v2 (version-tag) in .github/workflows/e2e-test.yml
findings.description: .github/workflows/e2e-test.yml references the action actions/cache at 'v2', a version-tag reference that its publisher can move after review.
uncertainties: A mutable reference is a configuration weakness, not evidence that the action is malicious.
Publisher 'actions' is GitHub-owned; the reference is still mutable.
recommendations: Pin to the full 40-character commit SHA of a reviewed release (keep the tag as a comment) and update pins deliberately.
